summary: Deputies were sent at 7:19 p.m. to check on three young children, three to six years old, reported to be outside in the company of three adults.
Officers were sent at 7:31 p.m. to a motel on the frontage road for a welfare check on a man who called 911 saying he was scared, with someone arguing in the background.

A vehicle hit a cyclist at North Chester Avenue and Roberts Lane at 7:40 p.m. and left. The vehicle, described as a maroon or red Toyota with front-end damage and its bumper missing, was last seen eastbound on East Roberts Lane, and a white Honda CR-V was later reported trying to pick up the missing bumper.
Crews were sent at 7:42 p.m. to a vehicle fire in the 3600 block of Sewell Street.
Crews were sent at 7:55 p.m. for an outside fire east of the airport, just north of State Road.
Officers were sent at 8:09 p.m. after two people were reported to be throwing bottles at passing vehicles.
Medics were sent at 8:11 p.m. to a home on Valhalla Drive for a traumatic injury.
Officers were sent at 8:23 p.m. for a welfare check on a woman reported to be the victim of a battery; the suspect was known to the caller.
Crews were sent at 8:34 p.m. to the 15800 block of L Street for a warm wall above a light socket.
Wasco police asked for a K9 unit at 8:49 p.m. for a subject barricaded in a home in the 2200 block of 3rd Street, wanted on a protective order violation.
Officers were sent at 9:16 p.m. to the 3100 block of Pioneer Drive for a disturbance between a man and his mother.

Deputies were sent at 9:36 p.m. to a home on Diane Drive after a woman yelled get away, gave her address, screamed and the line went dead. A subject was reported to have tried to open a door, and three children between 6 and 12 were in the house.
Officers were sent at 10:01 p.m. to the 3100 block of Monterey Street where two people were reported to be throwing appliances at each other.
Officers were sent at 10:10 p.m. to the 300 block of Beardsley Avenue to find someone wanted by the courts.
Crews and Delano police were sent at 10:47 p.m. to a rollover where a vehicle was on its roof in the roadway; one patient was reported.
Officers were sent at 11:33 p.m. to the 5000 block of Pierce Road after a juvenile reported his mother had hit him with a meat cleaver; two juveniles were to be checked on.
Officers were sent at 11:49 p.m. to the 1400 block of East 9th Street where a victim of an assault with an iron object was reported.
Officers were sent at 12:11 a.m. to a room on East Brundage Lane for a welfare check on a woman reported to be fighting with a man; one person was detained.
Medics were sent at 12:15 a.m. for a 14-year-old with alcohol poisoning.
Officers were sent at 12:24 a.m. after a report of a possible suicide attempt.
Officers were sent at 12:27 a.m. to an apartment on Dana Street for a suspicious person.
Crews were sent at 12:38 a.m. to the 1800 block of Niles Street for fire against a building; the first engine put it out and the rest of the response was cancelled.
Officers were sent at 12:41 a.m. to the 3000 block of Glenwood for a fight between a man and a woman that was reported to be out of control.
Officers were sent at 1:12 a.m. for a teenager reported to be running in and out of traffic on Calloway Drive.
Officers were sent at 1:36 a.m. to the 3600 block of Titan Lane after several 911 calls from different numbers, the last one a woman who sounded panicked, said hello and hung up.
Officers were sent at 1:41 a.m. to a convenience store on Union Avenue where employees reported a woman had a firearm, with a possible print of one showing inside her jacket.
The CHP was called at 2:17 a.m. after a black Honda hit something north of the Highway 99 split; the caller stopped responding.

Officers were sent at 2:36 a.m. to a priority domestic in the 8100 block of Seminole Court; one person reported being cut with a box cutter and the other was reported to be sitting on a bed with the box cutter.

area: Dr Martin Luther King Jr Boulevard
summary: Officers were sent at 2:50 a.m. to the 300 block of Dr Martin Luther King Jr Boulevard for a domestic in progress in the street.
Officers were sent at 2:59 a.m. to the 5200 block of Stockdale Highway where an employee was reported to be loitering.
Officers were sent at 3:08 a.m. to the 2900 block of Descanso Street for a domestic that had just happened.
Officers were sent at 3:28 a.m. to the 2400 block of Lake Street for a man in his 30s reported to be loitering.
Officers were sent at 3:58 a.m. to the 7900 block of White Lane for a battery at a grocery store.
Crews were sent at 4:19 a.m. to a market in the 9500 block of South Union Avenue where a woman was reported to have set a fire at the back of the building and was being argumentative.
Crews and the CHP were sent at 5:34 a.m. to a two-vehicle crash at the Highway 33 and Highway 58 split.
A crash at 5:51 a.m. a mile south of Highway 65 on Highway 99 left a pickup in the center divide and a sedan blocking the fast lane.
Building fire reported on East California Avenue.
Man with gun threatening people near auto shop.
Small towel fire at 50th Street and H Street.
Juvenile reportedly threatens mother at residence.
Traffic stop on silver Buick with expired plates.
Fire pit in backyard determined safe.
Smoke reported near trash can by highway business.
Request for public service assistance at Keller Drive.
